mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_tool_invocation ( run_id, llm_invocation_id, tool_call_id, dispatch_index, agent_name, step_no, tool_name, tool_provider, input_json, llm_oberserve, status, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{llmInvocationId}, #{toolCallId}, #{dispatchIndex}, #{agentName}, #{stepNo}, #{toolName}, #{toolProvider}, #{inputJson}, #{llmObservation}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_tool_invocation SET status = #{status}, llm_oberserve = #{llmObservation}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL OR #{finishedAt} IS NULL THEN duration_ms ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{finishedAt}) / 1000 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_tool_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY llm_invocation_id ASC, dispatch_index ASC, id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.run_id, t.llm_invocation_id, r.request_id, r.session_id, t.tool_call_id, t.dispatch_index, t.agent_name, t.step_no, t.tool_name, t.tool_provider, t.input_json, t.llm_oberserve, t.status, t.error_msg, t.duration_ms, COALESCE(a.artifact_count, 0) AS artifact_count, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.create_time FROM ai_agent_tool_invocation t INNER JOIN ai_agent_dialogue_run r ON r.id = t.run_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tool_invocation_id, COUNT(*) AS artifact_count FROM ai_agent_artifact WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY tool_invocation_id ) a ON a.tool_invocation_id = t.id WHERE t.tool_name = #{toolName} AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
